facts.did: 在接下来的十个行星自转周期里，Gardenpath 与 Unnamed（Murtis）形成了一套日常作息
facts.anchor: the Unnamed and the person developed a routine

facts.did: 每天早上装作吃饭、睡觉，同时偷偷写满自己的秘密笔记本
facts.anchor: while surreptitiously filling up their secret notebook

facts.did: 替 Murtis 把体内的毒素清出去
在 lupanar 的第十一个夜晚之后，带 Gardenpath 长途步行到城东，看一群 Unnamed 在运动场训练
facts.anchor: Murtis took them on a long walk to the east side of town

facts.did: 被 Murtis 追问“发生了什么”时回答：自己想来到这里、来到这个地方
facts.anchor: I wanted to get here, to this place.

facts.did: 反问确认这座城是否叫 Pompeii（此前不知道 Unnamed 有城市）
facts.anchor: Is Pompeii the name of this city?

facts.did: 在宅邸外指着花园，说明 peristyle 就是环绕花园、由柱子支撑的步道
facts.anchor: the peristyle—the path around the garden, with the columns

facts.did: 点头，接受在 Pompeii 城使用 Peristyle 这个名字
facts.anchor: Peristyle nodded. This would be the name they used

relations.relation: 照顾/关心：给了 Gardenpath 一个温暖的拥抱，并问是否有人伤害过她
relations.anchor: Did somebody hurt you? You can tell me.

relations.relation: 隐瞒真实动机的欺骗：Gardenpath 因不得不就原因欺骗 Murtis 而开始感到刺痛不适
relations.anchor: having to deceive Murtis about why

relations.relation: 取名者：Murtis 笑着问能否叫 Gardenpath 为 Peristyle
relations.anchor: Can I call you Peristyle? It’s a pretty name

relations.relation: 发现者：Murtis 问对方是否记得自己是怎么发现她的——当时她几乎走不动、衣服被撕掉
relations.anchor: You were barely able to walk, and your clothes were torn

relations.relation: 朋友：Gardenpath 开始把一个多细胞动物当作朋友
relations.anchor: starting to think of a multicellular animal as a friend

numbers.fact: 接下来的十个行星自转周期里，二者形成了日常作息
numbers.anchor: Over the next ten planetary rotations

numbers.fact: 在 lupanar 的第十一个夜晚之后，Murtis 带 Gardenpath 去城东看训练
numbers.anchor: After the eleventh night at the lupanar

numbers.fact: Murtis 领 Gardenpath 离开主街、向北走了两个街区
numbers.anchor: off the main street and north for two blocks

numbers.fact: 那座占满一个街区的宅邸有三层高
numbers.anchor: a block-long estate, three levels high
